note: Floors are whole percents. A pull request may raise a floor freely. Lowering one metric by at most 1 percentage point needs a coverage-exception floor line naming package, metric, old, and new. A larger drop is accepted only while base coverage.runsettings still lists CompilerGenerated, the head removes it, each lowered metric's reason contains Lücken-Baseline, and the new floor is not below the measured percent rounded down. linesTarget is strict greater-than and branchesTarget is greater-than-or-equal, and only when COVERAGE_ENFORCE=true. Z1 sets that switch true. On push to master the floor comparison is a warning.
